It contains no financial results, performance metrics, or comparison to expectations. The announcement is purely procedural regarding debt issuance and listing compliance.

results.headline: Notice of Interim Results
results.key_quote: THG PLC will publish its results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 on Thursday 10 September 2026.
results.summary: This is a notice of interim results announcement only, providing details of when THG will publish its half-year results and the timing of the analyst conference call. No actual results, performance metrics, or comparisons to expectations have been disclosed. The announcement contains no information comparing performance to guidance, expectations, or forecasts.

results.headline: Statement re Harworth’s response to Bidco's offer
results.key_quote: Net asset value is declining with EPRA NDV per share for H1 down 4.3% to 214.8 pence and statutory NAV per share down 4.2% to 206.5 pence; Total accounting return ("TAR") for the last 18 months has been negative 1.4%
results.summary: This is a takeover bid response statement from BidCo (Peel Pepper UK Limited) regarding Harworth's H1 2026 results. The statement contains no comparison of Harworth's results to pre-stated expectations, guidance, or forecasts. Instead, BidCo presents critical observations on Harworth's financial performance, including declining NAV, negative returns, worsening cashflow, and strategic concerns. The document is a bid defense/offer commentary rather than a results statement with expectation comparisons.
